desc:
A visual campaign project created for Vivo V70 FE x POP MART ZSIGA, combining playful character storytelling with polished product-focused visuals. The DOPIOUS Team was responsible for developing the visual direction from storyboard planning to 3D composition, rendering, and final image refinement.

Storyboard Design

name: KUN JIM DIOSIAM DESSERT SHOP
desc:
The KUN JIM DIOSIAM Dessert Booth is designed to create a premium Thai dessert experience within a compact retail format. The design combines contemporary elegance with traditional Thai identity, transforming the booth into a visually distinctive destination that attracts customers from multiple directions.

The overall concept focuses on presenting authentic Thai desserts through a modern and sophisticated architectural language. Warm wood textures, deep burgundy tones, and gold metallic accents are carefully selected to reflect the richness of Thai culture while maintaining a clean and luxurious appearance suitable for modern shopping malls and exhibition environments.
galleryCaptions: The booth layout is designed with an open-counter configuration to maximize customer accessibility and product visibility. Transparent glass display counters allow desserts to become the visual centerpiece of the space, enhancing customer engagement and encouraging impulse purchases. The curved brass framing elements introduce softness and refinement, inspired by traditional Thai decorative patterns.

Branding elements are integrated seamlessly into the upper fascia panels to ensure strong visibility from long distances while maintaining a balanced and elegant composition. The suspended menu display system helps organize product information clearly without creating visual clutter.

name: Symphony of ' Misterio Tent '
desc:
Artistry Unveiled: The Mesmeric Design Symphony of 'Misterio Tent'

Step into the enchanting realm of "Misterio Tent," an unfolding masterpiece that marries the swift functionality of a pop-up shop with the timeless allure of Art Deco elegance. This ephemeral installation, designed to be both luxuriously opulent and gracefully foldable, beckons those who seek a momentary escape into a world of wonder and mystery. Join us on a transformative journey through a pop-up experience that transcends the ordinary and embraces the extraordinary.
galleryCaptions: "Misterio Tent" is a choreography of form and function, where the rapid dance of foldability meets the symphony of luxurious design. As the tent gracefully unfolds, it reveals an Art Deco-inspired spectacle that captures the essence of a bygone era. The structure itself becomes a performance, a testament to efficiency wrapped in an aesthetic dance that sets the stage for the extraordinary experience within.

As the tent unfolds with a captivating speed, it unveils more than just a space; it unravels an experience. The quick and e!icient transformation becomes a spectacle in itself, a performance that de"ies the conventional boundaries of a pop-up shop. The transpar-ency of the fabric allows glimpses into the luxurious interior, inviting the curious to venture inside and discover the hidden treasures beneath the surface.

name: Bangkok Boulevard – Neoclassic House Renovation & Decoration
desc: The interior concept combines neoclassical detailing with contemporary comfort. White marble textures, warm wood flooring, black accent elements, soft fabric textures, and layered lighting are carefully integrated to create a sophisticated yet welcoming home. Each area is designed to feel connected through consistent materials, proportions, and lighting mood, while still allowing every room to have its own character.
galleryCaptions: A key part of the renovation is the improvement of the house layout and visual flow. The living area, dining space, bedroom, walk-in closet, and entertainment room are planned with attention to scale, furniture placement, circulation, and lifestyle usage. Decorative elements such as custom built-in cabinets, feature walls, arched glass doors, indirect ceiling lighting, and statement pendant lights help elevate the overall spatial experience.
The result is a modern neoclassical residence that feels elegant, warm, and internationally polished — a home that combines luxury presentation with comfortable functionality for daily living.
Scope of Work
Interior renovation design, space planning, decoration concept, material and lighting direction, custom built-in design, furniture styling, and 3D visualization.

name: Bangkok Fashion Week Key Visual
desc: In the avant-garde realm of Bangkok Fashion Week, we present our pièce de résistance—the 3D modeling key visual that seamlessly blends futuristic aesthetics witha unique 3D character. An exploration in mixed media, where fabric intertwines with digital realms, this visual spectacle is a stunning testament to the convergenceof fashion, technology, and artistic innovation.
galleryCaptions: Our foray into the Bangkok Fashion Week key visual began with a commitment to the future of style. The 3D modeling incorporates futuristic elements, from sleek lines to geometric patterns, creating a visual language that transcends the boundaries of contemporary fashion. Every curve, every detail is a nod to the cutting edge
of design, inviting viewers to embark on a journey into the fashion of tomorrow.

name: Ganesha for Silpakorn University
desc:

With an unwavering dedication to superlative details and meticulous texture work, we endeavored to transcend the digital medium, crafting a Ganesha that not only captivates the eye but elevates
the spirit, creating a virtual sanctuary that beckons people to prayer.

The Ganesha 3D modeling journey embarked with a commitment to breathe life into the divine. Every contour, every symbolic element was meticulously crafted withan attention to detail that goes beyond the ordinary. The virtual sculpture became a canvas of devotion, each detail a brushstroke in the creation of a digital deity that
captures the essence of Ganesha's sacred presence.
galleryCaptions: The texture work in our 3D modeling transcends the visual; it becomes a spiritual language that speaks to the soul. The choice of materials and the painstaking rendering of textures were done with the intention to create a tactile experience that fosters a sense of connection. The hands that virtually run over the surface encounter not just a digital representation but a textured prayer, inviting a profound engagement with the divine.

Our Ganesha 3D model is not conned to the digital realm; it aspires to influence the atmosphere of Silpakorn University. The meticulous designand texture work aim to create an ambiance that goes beyond pixels on a screen. It aspires to be a digital sanctum, where the mere act of viewing invites a moment of prayer, transforming the virtual space into a haven for spiritual contemplation.

Ganesha 3D modeling for Silpakorn University stands as a digital testament to our commitment to artistry and spiritual elevation. Beyond the intricacies of virtual design, it extends an invitation to prayer, a bridge between the physical and the virtual, where pixels become a conduit for
divine connection.
Join us in this exploration of the sacred through the lens of digital artistry, where each detail is a step closer to a moment of spiritual transcendence.

name: Xari Max
desc:
Xari Max: Elevating Elegance in Child Mobility with a Design Tailored for Larger Kids

The collaboration between Dopious and Mimakids is evident in every detail of the Xari Max, where design excellence meets the practical needs of larger kids. The stroller represents a shared commitment to pushing the boundaries of innovation in child mobility. Dopious brings its visionary design philosophy, while Mimakids contributes its deep understanding of child development and safety. The result is a stroller that not only accommodates the size of older children but does so with an elegance that is characteristic of both collaborators.
galleryCaptions: Dopious and Mimakids have seamlessly integrated their respective strengths into the design of the Xari Max. The larger seating area and adjustable features are a testament to Mimakids' expertise in creating products that prioritize the comfort and safety of children. Dopious, known for its avant-garde design sensibilities, has contributed to the stroller's aesthetic appeal, ensuring that the Xari Max not only serves a functional purpose but also stands out as a symbol of re!ined elegance in the realm of child mobility.

name: Mo’s Family Residence
desc: This residential project was thoughtfully designed for “Mo” and a family with three children, balancing aesthetics, functionality, and budget-conscious construction within an approximate construction budget of 2 million THB. The design embraces a warm contemporary style with natural wood textures, soft daylight, and calm earthy tones to create a home that feels cozy, timeless, and highly livable.
galleryCaptions: The overall concept focuses on creating a practical family home that supports everyday life while maintaining a refined and elegant atmosphere. Open-plan living spaces were designed to maximize natural light and visual openness, helping the house feel larger and more connected despite the controlled budget. Warm wood finishes, soft fabrics, and integrated lighting details add depth and comfort throughout the interior.

A special emphasis was placed on the children’s spaces, designing playful yet calming bedrooms that encourage creativity, imagination, and family bonding. Each children’s room was carefully planned with soft color palettes, functional storage, and flexible layouts that can adapt as the children grow. Elements such as reading corners, play areas, and gentle natural lighting help create a nurturing environment while still maintaining a clean and cohesive overall design language.

The kitchen, walk-in closet, living room, laundry area, and master bedroom were all designed with efficiency and long-term usability in mind. Built-in furniture solutions help optimize storage while keeping the interiors visually clean and organized. Material selections were carefully curated to achieve a premium visual feel while remaining cost-effective and practical for real-life family use.

Rather than relying on expensive decorative elements, the project focuses on proportion, lighting, texture, and spatial warmth to elevate the atmosphere. The result is a sophisticated yet approachable home that reflects modern family living — comfortable, functional, and emotionally welcoming.
This project demonstrates how thoughtful interior design can create a high-end residential experience while maintaining realistic construction and budgeting considerations.

name: Golden Year of New Birth Snake 2025
desc:
Inspired by the symbolism of rebirth, transformation, and prosperity, the installation reinterprets the Year of the Snake through a contemporary sculptural language.
The geometric golden serpent emerges as a monumental centerpiece, blending artisanal elegance with futuristic minimalism — reflecting renewal, wisdom, and the beginning of a new cycle.
galleryCaptions: Warm ambient lighting, textured materials, and refined architectural composition create an immersive retail experience that embodies the sophisticated identity of Aesop while celebrating the spirit of APEC collaboration and cultural evolution.

name: Naka Charm
desc: Lapis Amument presents the Naka Charm — a symbolic jewelry piece inspired by the legendary Naga, a guardian of protection, prosperity, wisdom, and spiritual strength. Designed as a modern clip-on wrist charm, the piece blends sacred symbolism with a refined minimalist aesthetic, transforming ancient belief into contemporary wearable art.
galleryCaptions: The engraved cube detail reflects the flowing movement of the Naga, symbolizing resilience, transformation, and positive energy. Paired with the elegant teal cord, the design creates a balance between spirituality and timeless luxury.

Each piece has also undergone a traditional blessing ritual, adding spiritual intention and deeper meaning to the charm. More than an accessory, it becomes a personal talisman — created to carry protection, confidence, and prosperity into everyday life.

name: PAWANG Candle Display “Sacred Monolith”
desc:
Designed for PAWANG, this display concept transforms a product presentation into a sculptural spatial experience. Inspired by the timeless beauty of carved stone, sacred architecture, and ceremonial objects, the display was created to elevate each candle holder into a collectible art piece rather than a conventional retail product.

The overall form is composed of layered circular platforms emerging from a monolithic stone base, symbolizing ascension, ritual, and hierarchy. Each level gently guides the viewer’s eye upward, creating a natural visual journey through the collection while giving every product its own sense of importance and presence.
galleryCaptions: The textured surface was intentionally designed to resemble hand-carved mineral stone — raw yet refined — reflecting the balance between nature and luxury. This tactile finish contrasts beautifully with the smooth geometric candle holders and metallic gold accents, creating a sophisticated dialogue between softness, structure, and craftsmanship.

Warm cinematic lighting was used to enhance the emotional atmosphere of the display. Inspired by gallery exhibitions and luxury jewelry presentations, the lighting creates dramatic shadows and highlights the depth of the textures, allowing the products to feel intimate, premium, and almost ceremonial.

The gold detailing integrated into the base reinforces PAWANG’s elegant identity while subtly adding a sense of timeless luxury. Rather than overwhelming the display, the metallic elements were carefully minimized to maintain a calm and sculptural visual language.

name: SHU DAXIA FOOD CONTAINER
desc: SHU DAXIA is a custom food display tray design project created to elevate the restaurant’s hotpot serving experience. Inspired by traditional Chinese architecture and the strong visual identity of the brand, the product transforms a functional serving tray into a memorable presentation piece.
story:
The design features a multi-tier structure with removable stainless-steel trays, rich red wood textures, black roof elements, and gold decorative lattice details. Each layer is designed to resemble a miniature Chinese building, creating a strong visual impact while keeping the product practical for restaurant operation.

This project focuses on combining product design, brand storytelling, material expression, and food presentation into one cohesive customer experience.

name: SHU DAXIA FOOD CONTAINER
desc: A luxury studio product rendering for SHU DAXIA Hot Pot, featuring a black-and-gold Chinese mala hot pot on a deep red background with one-directional lighting. The image highlights the ornate dragon details, premium metallic finish, and elegant Chinese dining identity in a clean international visual style.
story:
A premium studio product rendering for SHU DAXIA Hot Pot, designed to present the product with a minimal luxury Chinese aesthetic. The visual focuses on a single ornate black-and-gold mala hot pot, positioned at the center of the composition against a deep red studio backdrop.

The lighting uses a single directional key light to create strong product definition, elegant shadows, and realistic metallic highlights on the gold dragon details. The overall mood is refined, luxurious, and international, while still keeping a clear Chinese restaurant identity. The composition is kept clean and minimal to make the hot pot the hero of the image, suitable for brand presentation, menu visuals, website hero banners, and promotional materials.

name: Nike Triple Launch Activation
desc: December Sunday and Dopious collaborated on the comprehensive design, production, and construction of this Nike retail activation at CentralWorld, with Dopious managing the full end-to-end workflow to successfully debut three new performance running models.
story:
End-to-End Project Management: From initial architectural concept and structural 3D modeling to the final on-site installation and hardware integration.

Environmental Branding: Executing the precise visual hierarchy required by the Nike brand, including the application of typography, light-box signage, and the "Try It On" neon call-to-action.

CMF & Technical Execution: Selecting and applying specific materials (matte steel, industrial mesh, performance rubber) and lighting solutions to ensure the installation functions as a high-traffic retail pop-up while maintaining a premium brand identity.

name: Self Kiosk Design Concept
desc: Scope: Decembersunday and Dopious+ collaborated on the comprehensive spatial design and conceptual development for the Self brand kiosk, This partnership focused on translating the brand identity into a cohesive retail environment, delivering a complete design solution for the kiosk’s aesthetic and functional layout.
story: Merging the creative vision of Decembersunday with the design expertise of Dopious+, we brought the Self kiosk to life through a meticulous conceptual development process. Our collaboration focused on more than just aesthetics; we engineered a retail environment where form meets function. From the brand-aligned visual language to the optimized functional layout, we provided a complete design roadmap that turns a retail space into an immersive brand experience.

name: Budweiser chiller Design & 3D Modeling
desc: Decembersunday and Dopious+ collaborated on the sculptural design and 3D modeling of an innovative, branded Budweiser display.
story:
Conceptual Innovation: This activation merges high-end artistic sculpture with functional utility, featuring a dynamic central cooling system that allows for the active chilling of Budweiser products within the sculpture’s core.

Design & Execution: The partnership involved the comprehensive 3D development of the human-scale figure, integrating visible cooling mechanics and temperature-control displays to elevate the consumer experience into an immersive brand statement.

name: VARORIOUS ARCADE COVER  DESIGN
desc: Dopious Design developed the exterior cover design for VALOROUS, an interactive arcade shooting game device. The design focuses on creating a strong futuristic identity that makes the machine feel like part of the game world, not only a display device.
story:
The overall form uses a bold sci-fi structure with angular protective frames, layered black metal panels, illuminated red lighting details, and tactical-inspired surfaces. The front area is designed to highlight the large game screen, while the lower section integrates weapon display zones, lighting strips, and branding panels to create a complete immersive arcade experience.

The design direction combines cinematic gaming atmosphere, cyberpunk lighting, industrial metal texture, and high-impact visual presentation. Red accent lighting is used to guide attention to the product details and make the machine stand out clearly in a dark arcade environment.

This case design was created to enhance the player experience, support the shooting game concept, and deliver a strong visual identity for commercial arcade spaces.

name: ZIGI KV
desc:
Compact Design, Global Reach
This Key Visual highlights the Mima Zigi as the perfect go-anywhere, compact stroller. By contrasting the stroller’s minimal footprint with epic global landmarks, the artwork shows that no destination is too big. The central runway and playful explorers represent seamless, effortless travel—proving that with Zigi, exploring the world with your child is easy, light, and limitless.
story:
This Key Visual positions the Mima Zigi as the ultimate compact travel stroller for modern, active families. The composition relies on a striking visual contrast: the sleek, space-saving design of the Zigi stroller juxtaposed against a massive, surreal landscape of iconic global landmarks.

The central airport runway serves as a metaphor for smooth, effortless travel, drawing the eye forward into a world of possibilities. The child's pointing arm and the adventurous kids riding alongside symbolize the freedom, joy, and boundless curiosity that comes with hassle-free mobility. By blending childhood imagination with premium travel aesthetics, the KV clearly communicates the core message: the Mima Zigi is so compact and easy to use, it turns the entire world into an accessible playground. Small footprint, limitless journeys.

name: Exoskeleton Assist System for Valorous
desc: This exoskeleton concept is designed for **Valorous**, a game project developed by **MotionX**, with concept design by **Dopious Design**. The design focuses on creating an in-game exoskeleton system that feels both futuristic and believable, based on real product design thinking and realistic mechanical movement.
story:
As a product design team, Dopious Design approached this project not only as a visual concept, but also as a functional object. The exoskeleton was designed with attention to real body movement, joint rotation, balance, support structure, and mechanical logic. The goal is to make the device look like it could exist as a real product, while still fitting naturally into the sci-fi game world.



The system is attached to the soldier’s body and supports key movement areas such as the spine, shoulders, arms, hips, knees, and ankles. Each joint includes visible mechanical elements such as pivot points, actuators, pistons, rails, bolts, support frames, and layered protective plates. These details help communicate how the exoskeleton assists movement during running, aiming, shooting, twisting, crouching, and close-combat action.



The design process combines product design, game concept design, and engineering logic. By working with an understanding of real movement and mechanical structure, the team aimed to create an exoskeleton that is visually strong, functional, and believable for gameplay animation.



The final visual direction uses matte dark grey tactical fabric, satin black metal, gunmetal components, and subtle metallic highlights. The result is a cinematic, tactical sci-fi exoskeleton that works as both a game asset and a realistic product-inspired design.
